items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network giving (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and its method follows the paper's subtract-old / compute / undo schedule and the forward-inverse-forward composition. The coefficient check is only alluded to ('intersection-size coefficients'): the net map (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, the neighbour rules and the stage values (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x) are not given.

N2 gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1} and that only endpoint frames matter; the method is the paper's invariant (stored array = frame of logical array) plus commutation of a common frame with a pointwise linear gate (lines 804-817). The signed route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is only paraphrased.

Comparable nondegenerate labels, the only decrease on central edges 3->4 losing h, and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 < 1/2 are stated correctly. The budget itself is reduced to 'below W m': L=Ich and sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L are missing, and the derivation omits the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (t_X perp t_Y) and the telescoping of source (N) and sink (Wm-N) dimensions.

N4/N4.2 state the projection assignment (P_U on gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} on X_a sources), the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m and s_b < W_b m; N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b, i.e. s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b. The method says every edge difference is a projection onto its residual with rank equal to the dimension change, omitting the N source edges (2P_{U_a}, rank one, zero dimension change) that the paper's count (1162-1166) depends on.

Kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c < W_c m, telescoping to C^{tensor m}, and the 27k inverse factors fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z are correct. The frame is given as the bare phase i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, without the H^{tensor m} conjugation that turns the character (-1)^{v.x} into the translation X_v (1254-1257), and s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c is not given.

The chain L/N < 1/2 -> deficit > 0 -> s < Wm and the claim that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, giving s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50}, follow the paper. The exact eta_b = 339/22587335000000 and eta_c = 73/19906842167500 are missing, as is the step log m < 20 giving m^tau > m(1-20*2^{-50}) > m(1-eta) (1332-1338).

Digit split/merge, digit moves, cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, controlled shifts by cut-and-remerge and unit multiplication by increasing pieces are stated and match the paper's proofs. T2 drops the condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time, and the fixed prime and denominator conditions, and omits the digit-pair permutation. The derivation lacks the counter analysis and the absorption b^C = O(Q) that make the cost O(V) rather than O(V log V).

The factorization A = E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, the topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, the sequence E_2, E_1^{-1}, Pi D, E_1, E_2^{-1}, and one H-D interchange per pivot via two controlled shifts all match lines 1375-1443. The choice of the fixed prime q avoiding denominators is not mentioned.

The steps follow the paper's route: cyclic row split into W role streams, an address shear on each edge by recursive interchanges, endpoint matrices giving H <- H+D on every row, the three updates D <- D-H, H <- H+D, D <- H-D, the recurrence F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with its geometric sum, and the fixed-tape parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node.

The statement (p,h,g,d,z) -> (p,d,g,h,z) in O(V u^tau) and the route (top rho digits as a row field of range >= W^k, padding rows, base-m pieces with a geometric sum, padding [2^u] to [q^e]) match the proof. The value rho = O(log e) is not given.

Conjugation by P_M, slots of f chunks, s_c children on e/m axes, inverse children via C^{-1} = -iZCZ at no extra call, M realized by elementary row additions, and H_0^{tensor D} = b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D all match lines 1835-1931. The phrase 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' is loose (see errors).

The eight parity-conditioned shifts (cycles (00 01 10) then (01 10 11)), each line as one cyclic shift between swaps, the bad set with guard interval [10, 2^{K-1}-11] and fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, the radix-sort repair, and the separate top-bit XOR follow the proof. The cost is stated as O(V(L^tau+1)) 'plus negligible repair terms' without the explicit MA^3 + delta_bad MA(R+A) terms or the family conditions (R superpolynomial, K/log p -> infinity) under which they are negligible.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), s children of volume V/W, rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, and the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^tau+1) are present. Missing are the leaf cutoff e < d^beta with F = O(e), the bound K <= e^{c/beta} with tau(1+c/beta) < lambda, and the leaf contribution e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}; together these give the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} < lambda'. L2.3's 'sums to O(e^lambda)' is therefore loose.

The layer in O(V d^{lambda'}) evaluated exactly with one final truncation, the guard width Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E with leaves 8e, epsilon C_1 < 1 giving Delta = o(p), and the truncation error < sqrt2 2^{-p} all follow the proof. The parameter bands (d = Theta(p^epsilon), K = floor(d^c)) and the lambda' conditions of the proposition are not stated.

These steps cover the paper's derivation: character cancellation by a shift of k with factor y^{r j_0} = -1, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage with B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the prefix-slot list O(dK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges costing O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), one layer per round, the monomial as a split, and truncation commuting with J_E for error < sqrt2 l 2^{-p}. The exact counterparts L B F^- and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1} appear only implicitly (H5).

Evaluation at B_0 = 2^{4p}, the 4pr-bit bound, four products with the established multiplier, centered residues with |h_j| < B_0/2, negacyclic wrap, and O(rp log(rp)) all match. The statement says 'truncating' without the normalization: the returned value is Q_p(fg/r).

The statement (M_r(f,g) = (f*g)/T, error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, cost) is right, and so are the retained LB order, the commutation of pointwise products with the record permutation, and the 3 delta + eta error budget. The normalization identity F^-(f*g) = M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^- = I/M, which justifies the final exact scale by M = T/r, is missing.

P_s F_s = 2^{2 alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with contractions, error < p^2, time O(t p^{3/2+delta} alpha), the tensor form with line-map cost O(dTp^{3/2+delta} alpha) and movement O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) are stated. The proof route (S, T, C, D, N = CTD, ||N-I|| < 1/2, left inverse D N^{-1} C, normalizations, ordered maps, axis-by-axis expansion, O(d^2) adjacent interchanges) is followed. The retained permutations (P_s u)_j = u_{tj} and (P_t v)_k = v_{-sk} are never defined.

The steps state the chirp a_j = exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i), Q F_t u = conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T, and (R F_s^+)[(R F_s u).(R F_s v)] = (u*v)/S^2. Both proofs follow the paper (coefficient comparison; dilation F^+ R_c = R_c^{-1} F^+ and the normalized convolution rule), with conjugation giving R F_s^+.

The exponent list, b, p, d, K, T, t_i in {r/2, r}, Tp = Theta(n), alpha, gamma = o(b), the prime intervals, gcd = 1, T/2 < S < T, the n^{o(1)} search and the no-wraparound digit bound are correct. eta = 1/(4d), r = 2^{ceil(log T / d)} and the check alpha^4 theta_i > p are missing, and the layer inequalities (4018-4036) are asserted rather than verified.

Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} with mu_i = P_i^{-1} mod s_i as a convolution-preserving isomorphism, the triangular update from i = d down to 1 by prefix-controlled rotations of the valid interval, and O(d^2) axis moves giving O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) match the paper. The explicit formula b_i = a_i + mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j is only paraphrased.

x_d -> zeta y with zeta = e^{pi i/r}, its well-definedness, the diagonal factor zeta^k, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j, and the computed twist/convolve/untwist sequence with phase errors < 2*2^{-p} follow the paper. The composite M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) = (f*g)/T is described in words only.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma, exact counterpart R F_s, opposite by conjugation) and the step sequence in A8 with the two occurrences of S explained in A9 match lines 4456-4544. The digit scaling a_j 2^{-b-2} is not mentioned, and the summary in A gives the rescaling as 'S and 2^{2b+4}' instead of S and 2^{2b+4}S.

The steps give error propagation through contractions, E_s = 9*2^gamma TL, the opposite-transform error (3E_s+2)h_p, the final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma} <= 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, and carry propagation with its invariant. Missing are E_w = S(3E_s+2) < 28*2^gamma T^2 L, from which 448 comes, the ring and complex-convolution bounds (5TL, 6TL), and gamma <= b/4.

V = Tp, seven dominant powers at most 1-2kappa, min g_i = g_2 = 2^{-181} = 2kappa, absorption of log p powers and the schoolbook cutoff are stated. The seven normalized terms are not listed in K, g_2 = epsilon c(1-tau) is not identified, and the setup and exceptional-stream sorting costs (4913-4981) are not accounted for.
R names 'nlogn-conjecture' only in its relies-on list. No step states the eventual lower bound T_A(n) >= c_A n lg n, its negation by liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: Labels are 'built from tensor powers of triple indicator vectors', and the motivation keeps the lost dimension 'small relative to the number of data banks'.
errors.paper: Labels are built from the tensor products u_a = t_{a_1} (x) t_{a_2} (x) t_{a_3} of three different triples' indicators, and the loss is kept small relative to N, the number of data pairs indexed by triples (there are two banks).

errors.says: Method: edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change.
errors.paper: This holds except for the N source edges of X_a, whose difference is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero. These N extra ranks make s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b (deficit N-2L_b) rather than Wm-2N+2L.

errors.says: Phase frames i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4} have frame changes that are products of translation kernels aI+bX_v.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U = H^{(x)m} diag(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{(x)m}. The Hadamard conjugation (H diag(1,-1) H = X) is what turns the character (-1)^{v.x} into the translation X_v; a diagonal phase frame alone would give diagonal edge changes.

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: For each edge, one child is applied on slot h for each h <= rho_edge (one per residual basis vector, at most m slots). s_c is the total number of children over all edges of one network invocation, not a number of slots.

errors.says: With exponents chosen so that a = s/W < m^lambda, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda).
errors.paper: The paper requires a <= m^sigma < m^lambda. It stops at e < d^beta with F(e) = O(e) and uses K <= e^{c/beta} with tau(1+c/beta) < lambda to make the internal sum O(e^lambda). The leaves add O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda' must exceed max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}.
The algorithm multiplies by S and then by 2^{2b+4}S, undoing (u*v)/S^2 and the two input scales 2^{-b-2}. A8 states this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. Two fast tape procedures are obtained from the bank-exchange network with s < Wm (N1-N6 feeding C1 and L); they serve the synthetic convolution (H), resampling with retained permutations and chirps (G3), the CRT/twist assembly (A), exact recovery (E) and the cost table (K). It thins at the rank budget: the network sizes h=100, N, m, the label budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the rank-one source-edge exception are absent, so s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b is reached only through the asserted deficit N-2L_b. It also thins in the layer recurrence (no leaf cutoff or lambda' condition) and in the time accounting (no setup or exceptional-sort costs).

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated with its mechanism. h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples, N = binom(h,3)^3 and m = h^3 are absent; N3 only names an 'm-dimensional' space F^{(x)3}, so the network's defining sizes are missing.
One frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the edge cost D_v D_u^{-1} (a change of frame) are all present.
Nondegenerate nested labels in the m-dimensional F^{(x)3}, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges being central wires 3->4 each losing h are stated.

The N4 method states the rank-equals-dimension mechanism (edge differences are projections onto residuals). It omits the required exception, the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change, so the step lacks part of its defining content. Conservative verdict.
N3 only says the total dimension change is below W m. L = Ich and sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L are absent; s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b appears only implicitly through the deficit N-2L_b in N4.1.
L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539, both below 1/2, and the positive deficit N-2L_b with s_b < W_b m are stated.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m for every role, with the X_a computation P_{U_a^perp} - (-P_{U_a}) = I_m, giving H <- H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A = E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a shear, and s recursive calls per node (C1.1 motivation, C1.1.4) are present.
Children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}, and F_k = O(e^tau) are present. The bridging inequality log m < 20 is not stated.

central.summary: Six of the nine steps are reconstructed: frames, labels, the strict saving L/N < 1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50}. The chain thins where labels become a rank count. The network's sizes (h=100, triples, N, m) are missing, the rank-equals-dimension step omits the N rank-one source edges, and the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich is absent, so s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b < W_b m rests on the stated deficit N-2L_b rather than on a reconstructed count.
